User-Restricted.description:
HMRC supports OAuth 2.0 for authenticating user restricted API requests using an OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token in the AUTHORIZATION header.
See https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/docs/authorisation/user-restricted-endpoints for details.

# Schemas and examples

You can download the following zipped archive, which contains XML schemas and examples of the request and response payloads for each of the API endpoints:

get.summary: Get a list of declaration versions by MRN

get.description: Get a list of declarations matching the query parameters

parameters.description: The party role. One of submitter, consignee, consignor or declarant. Only submitter is valid in this release.
parameters.name: partyRole

parameters.description: The category of a declaration. One of IM, EX, CO or ALL.
parameters.name: declarationCategory

parameters.description: For use in a future release.
parameters.name: eori

parameters.description: The declaration start date. If omitted, then the results start from the earliest declaration. If both dates are omitted then the default is the last 30 days.
parameters.name: dateFrom

parameters.description: The declaration end date. If omitted, then the results start from the dateFrom parameter to the current date. If both dates are omitted then the default is the last 30 days.
parameters.name: dateTo

parameters.description: The goods location code. Maximum length is 12 characters.
parameters.name: goodsLocationCode

parameters.description: The status of a declaration. One of cleared, uncleared, rejected or all. If omitted the default is uncleared.
parameters.name: declarationStatus

parameters.description: The page number of the results. Default value is 1.
parameters.name: pageNumber
